question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Occurence**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the given word "Occurence" is "***Occurrence***".
 
• An event or anything that happens is defined as an occurrence.
 
• ***Example***: Common occurrences include lightning.
